english.note: Use this for a passenger viewed as a traveller, especially on longer journeys, at airports, or in formal travel contexts rather than an ordinary local rider.
Use this only when the broad sense of pilgrim is simply a traveller, without emphasis on religion or a pilgrimage.

examples.english: Every passenger, please queue at the boarding gate.
examples.traditional: 每位旅客請喺登機閘口排隊。
